name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
summary: At the river west of Stonefield Farm, Tommy Joe Stonefield longs for Maybell Maclure. Their families have feuded for years, so he relies on secret notes and quiet banks to keep their love hidden.

sections.title: A Star-Crossed Feud
sections.body: Tommy Joe Stonefield waits by the river west of Stonefield Farm, looking toward the Maclure homestead across the water. The Stonefields and Maclures have clashed for years over land, pride, and farmyard squabbles. Their elders keep the feud alive, but Tommy Joe has fallen in love with Maybell Maclure. The two cannot meet openly without angering both households. Gramma Stonefield, Tommy Joe’s sympathetic grandmother, helps them exchange secret notes and tokens of affection.

faq.answer: Tommy Joe Stonefield is a young human who lives on Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest. He is secretly in love with Maybell Maclure, daughter of his family’s bitter rivals.

faq.q: Where can I find Tommy Joe Stonefield?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe Stonefield stands on the riverbank west of Stonefield Farm, looking across the water toward the Maclure farmstead where Maybell lives.

faq.q: Why are the Stonefields and Maclures fighting?
aliases: why do they hate each other
faq.answer: No one says what began the feud. The Stonefields and Maclures have kept up their bitter rivalry for years, and neither family wants its young ones associating with the other.

faq.q: Who helps Tommy Joe and Maybell meet?
faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield knows of their affection and helps their secret courtship. She uses travelers to carry discreet messages between Tommy Joe and Maybell.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer in southern Elwynn, you may find Tommy Joe’s secret romance a reminder of the quiet personal lives that continue amid banditry and political unrest.
